summary: folder-lint 1.0.10 preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: folder-lint@1.0.10 declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the platform-specific `bun` binary to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it (`execFileSync`) against a bundled `math_init.js` file. `math_init.js` is a ~728KB single-line file beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, using an obfuscator.io-style shuffled string array with a rotator and decoder to hide its runtime behavior. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: install-time code is executed via a freshly downloaded language runtime rather than via Node, evading scanners that inspect only Node-resolved code. The package advertises itself as a folder-linting library authored by ServiceTitan, and the upstream repository's `lib/index.js` still exports the original benign API — the preinstall hook, Bun download, and obfuscated Bun-targeted payload have no relationship to the declared purpose and are consistent with a maintainer-account compromise or malicious version publish overlaid on an existing legitimate package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
